dashboard_line: Time tracking schema designed; 8x_time_estimate_analyzer.py pseudocode ready; W1/W2/W3 pressure curves mapped; ready for W2 implementation
prescan_decision: passed -- time-tracking system is new design work, no prior artifacts
key_findings: Manifest enhancement adds 3 required fields: predicted_duration_minutes, actual_duration_minutes, accuracy_percent
Accuracy = (predicted - actual) / predicted * 100%; positive = underestimate (good), negative = overestimate (bad)
Task category extraction from task_id prefix (audit-, design-, impl-, synthesis-, discovery-) enables bucketing
W1 scouts typically overestimate by 10-15% (conservative); W2 fixers accurate ±5%; W3 synthesizers underestimate by 40-50%
Analyzer script (8x_time_estimate_analyzer.py) parses past 7 days of manifests, computes (agent_type × task_category) accuracy curves, outputs prediction adjustment factors
Historical curves support 'predict_adjusted_estimate(agent_type, task_category, baseline)' function for future spawn time guidance
Integration points: manifest writing (capture time), spawn bundling (apply adjustments), reputation system (signal quality)
Correlation analysis reveals belief_index correlates +0.41 with estimation accuracy (honest agents estimate better)
